description: PostgreSQL 18 timetz offset storage, precision, comparison, casts, arithmetic, indexing, and validation
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_timetz (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TIMETZ(3) UNIQUE);
SELECT id, value FROM type_matrix_timetz ORDER BY value, id;
SELECT '12:34:56+02'::timetz AS plus2, '12:34:56+02:30'::timetz AS plus230, '12:34:56-03:30:15'::timetz AS negative, '12:34:56Z'::timetz AS zulu, '12:34:56'::timetz AS implicit_zone;
SELECT '23:00:00+02'::timetz + interval '2 hours' AS plus_interval, '01:00:00-03'::timetz - interval '2 hours' AS minus_interval, interval '1.25 seconds' + '12:00:00+05:30'::timetz AS reverse_plus;

SELECT '04:00:00+02'::timetz = '01:00:00-01'::timetz AS same_utc_different_offset, '04:00:00+02'::timetz < '04:00:00+01'::timetz AS utc_order, '04:00:00+02'::timetz < '03:00:00+01'::timetz AS offset_tie_break;
SELECT id FROM type_matrix_timetz WHERE value = '12:34:56+02'::timetz(3);
